rationale: Sampled ContinuityOps tree is a strong repo-only lab scaffold: hardened Helm, real SQS worker semantics, SLO/alert catalogs, eight drills, and default-deny agentic controls with honest synthetic labels. Score is merit-only; no pass threshold was provided or applied.
